sources.source: script Root version "1.0.0"; behavior Base { state alive: Bool = true; on update { if alive { log "base"; } } } behavior Child { use Base; state speed: Rat = 1; on update { if alive { speed = speed + 1; } } } entity E { use Child; on update { alive = false; speed = 2; } }
script Root version "1.0.0"; import child; entity E { use Child; on update { alive = false; speed = 3; } }
module child version "1.0.0"; import base; export behavior Child { use Base; state speed: Rat = 1; on update { if alive { speed = speed + 1; } } }
module base version "1.0.0"; export behavior Base { state alive: Bool = true; on update { if alive { log "alive"; } } }
script Root version "1.0.0"; behavior A { on pulse(x: Int) { log "a"; } } behavior B { use A; on pulse(y: Int) { log "b"; } } entity E { use B; on pulse(z: Int) { log "e"; } }

script Root version "1.0.0"; behavior Producer { on start { emit pulse(1); } } behavior Consumer { on pulse(value: Rat) { log "pulse"; } } entity E { use Producer; use Consumer; on update { return; } }
script Root version "1.0.0"; behavior A { on update { log "a"; } } behavior B { on update { animate "Walk"; } } entity E { use A; use B; on update { move vec2(1, 0); } }
script Root version "1.0.0"; behavior A { use B; } behavior B { use A; } entity E { use A; on start { return; } }
script Root version "1.0.0"; behavior A { state a: Int = 0; } behavior B { use A; } behavior C { use A; } entity E { use B; use C; on start { return; } }
script Root version "1.0.0"; behavior A { state x: Int = 0; } behavior B { state x: Int = 1; } entity E { use A; use B; on start { return; } }
script Root version "1.0.0"; behavior A { state x: Int = 0; } entity E { use A; state x: Int = 1; on start { return; } }
script Root version "1.0.0"; behavior A { on pulse(x: Int) { log "a"; } } behavior B { on pulse(x: Rat) { log "b"; } } entity E { use A; use B; on start { return; } }
script Root version "1.0.0"; behavior Base { state value: Int = 0; } behavior Child { use Base; on pulse(value: Int) { log "x"; } } entity E { use Child; on start { return; } }
script Root version "1.0.0"; behavior Left { on update { right = 1; } } behavior Right { state right: Int = 0; } entity E { use Left; use Right; on start { return; } }
script Root version "1.0.0"; behavior A { on a { emit ping(1); } } behavior B { on b { emit ping("x"); } } entity E { use A; use B; on start { return; } }

script Root version "1.0.0"; behavior Producer { on start { emit pulse("bad"); } } behavior Consumer { on pulse(value: Rat) { log "pulse"; } } entity E { use Producer; use Consumer; on update { return; } }
